items.title: Write the bounded document-context scaling execution plan
items.context: Specify authority layers, retrieval pipeline, context budgets, escalation rules, provenance/read-manifest evidence, stale/conflict behavior, rollout milestones, threat model, verification matrix, migration strategy, observability, rollback, and measurable success criteria for repositories with 1000+ documents.
items.userSees: A reviewable Markdown execution plan with explicit architecture, controls, milestones, and acceptance criteria.
excludes: Deleting or bulk-rewriting existing decision documents
